title: Where do the metrics go?

scenes.heading: Where does this metric belong?
scenes.sub: An inference cluster needs two paths
voice: Your inference team wants dashboards and autoscaling.
Both use metrics, so it helps to know which path each one will take.

scenes.heading: Send signals to your backend
voice: Most stock AICR recipes include the NVKE Telemetry Pipeline to collect cluster signals.
Point its exporters at your production backend and configure the access, retention, and alerts your team needs.

scenes.heading: Follow the runtime query separately
scenes.sub: Keep the autoscaling metrics path visible
voice: The separate runtime Prometheus server keeps series that enabled components declare.
For a workload-specific series, you can extend the series list in the bundle configuration.

scenes.heading: Trace a query to its consumer
scenes.detail: Add an adapter rule if needed
scenes.result: The two paths serve their readers
voice: The backend receives telemetry for operators to explore.
When wiring up autoscaling, the adapter can read a retained runtime series through its configured rule.

viewer: Platform engineer configuring a production metrics backend
payoff: The episode separates NKTP’s observability export from the runtime Prometheus queries used by components such as the autoscaling adapter.
